<title level="1" right="Spell 1" pfs="Standard">
[Phantasmal Minion](/Spells.aspx?ID=1631)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Summon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=520" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 349

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

**Deities**
[Anubis](/Deities.aspx?ID=49), [Kols](/Deities.aspx?ID=89), [Monad](/Deities.aspx?ID=141)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained
</row>

</column>

---

You summon a [phantasmal minion](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2750). The minion is roughly the shape of a humanoid. You can choose to have it be [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26) or have an ephemeral appearance, but it's obviously a magical effect, not a real creature.
name: Phantasmal Minion
